extra_info: Ayutthaya is a historic city in Thailand and a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for the ruins of its former capital and Buddhist temples.
task_instruction: Rewrite each direct request or order as reported speech.
paragraphs: A group of students visits the historic city of Ayutthaya in Thailand. Their guide, Mali, welcomes them near the entrance. Mali asked the students, {{red:Please stay with the group.}} {{mask_1}} She then told them, {{red:Keep the entrance clear.}} {{mask_2}}

Before they walk toward the old temple ruins, Mali gives a few simple instructions. She asked the students, {{red:Please listen to the safety information.}} {{mask_3}} A visitor asked his friend, {{red:Please take a photo of me here.}} {{mask_4}} Mali reminded everyone, {{red:Do not climb on the old walls.}} {{mask_5}}

The group follows a path between historic buildings. Mali asked them, {{red:Please walk slowly on the uneven path.}} {{mask_6}} She told them, {{red:Look at the map before we turn.}} {{mask_7}} A student asked Mali, {{red:Please explain the name of this monument.}} {{mask_8}} Mali shared a short explanation about its history.

At a shaded rest area, Mali gives the group time to drink water. She told them, {{red:Put your bottles in your bags.}} {{mask_9}} Then she asked, {{red:Please wait here for five minutes.}} {{mask_10}} One student reminded a classmate, {{red:Do not leave your hat on the bench.}} {{mask_11}}

The students continue to another monument, where signs explain the site rules. Mali told the group, {{red:Read the information sign.}} {{mask_12}} She asked them, {{red:Please speak quietly near the visitors who are praying.}} {{mask_13}} A student asked another student, {{red:Please show me where the next building is on the map.}} {{mask_14}}

Near a small museum, Mali explains how to protect the objects inside. She told the students, {{red:Do not touch the displays.}} {{mask_15}} She asked them, {{red:Please leave your large bags by the entrance.}} {{mask_16}} A museum worker told the visitors, {{red:Turn off the flash on your cameras.}} {{mask_17}}

Before the visit ends, Mali gathers the students near the meeting point. She asked them, {{red:Please check that you have all your belongings.}} {{mask_18}} She told them, {{red:Stay behind the marked line.}} {{mask_19}} A student asked Mali, {{red:Please tell us where the bus is waiting.}} {{mask_20}} The group thanked Mali for helping them enjoy the monuments respectfully.
